author: cairn
blurb: Send messages, search channels, and read conversations in Slack.

definition.name: Slack
definition.description: Slack — messages, channels, and search. Slack forbids dynamic client registration, so after installing: create a Slack app at api.slack.com/apps, enable PKCE, add a Redirect URL of the form http://127.0.0.1:<port>/callback, then paste the app's public Client ID + that Redirect URL into the server's OAuth fields before signing in.
